definitions.rationale: Defines the integralV classifier by mutually exclusive Int/Bool membership and exclusion of Float.
definitions.text:
rule integralV(V:Val)
    => ( (isInt(V) andBool notBool isBool(V))
         orBool
         (isBool(V) andBool notBool isInt(V)) )
       andBool notBool isFloat(V)

definitions.rationale: Defines the floatV classifier by Float membership and exclusion of Int and Bool.
definitions.text:
rule floatV(V:Val)
    => isFloat(V)
       andBool notBool isInt(V)
       andBool notBool isBool(V)

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining allIntegral on the empty value sequence.
definitions.text: rule allIntegral(.ValSeq) => true [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Structural recurrence defining allIntegral on a cons sequence.
definitions.text:
rule allIntegral(vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => integralV(V) andBool allIntegral(R)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the integer accumulator summary sumInts.
definitions.text: rule sumInts(ACC:Int, .ValSeq) => ACC [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Tail-recursive equation defining sumInts on a nonempty sequence.
definitions.text:
rule sumInts(ACC:Int, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => sumInts(ACC +Int intLikeTotal(V), R)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining allNumeric on the empty value sequence.
definitions.text: rule allNumeric(.ValSeq) => true [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Structural recurrence defining allNumeric from the head classifier and tail predicate.
definitions.text:
rule allNumeric(vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => (integralV(V) orBool floatV(V))
       andBool allNumeric(R)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining hasFloat on the empty value sequence.
definitions.text: rule hasFloat(.ValSeq) => false [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Structural recurrence defining hasFloat on a cons sequence.
definitions.text:
rule hasFloat(vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => floatV(V) orBool hasFloat(R)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the Float-accumulator summary sumFloatRest.
definitions.text:
rule sumFloatRest(ACC:Float, .ValSeq) => ACC
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recurrence defining sumFloatRest when the next modeled value is a Float.
definitions.text:
rule sumFloatRest(ACC:Float, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => sumFloatRest(addF(ACC, projectFloatTotal(V)), R)
    requires floatV(V)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recurrence defining sumFloatRest when the next modeled value is integral.
definitions.text:
rule sumFloatRest(ACC:Float, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => sumFloatRest(addF(ACC, intToF(intLikeTotal(V))), R)
    requires integralV(V)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded fallback recurrence completing the definition of sumFloatRest off its numeric use domain.
definitions.text:
rule sumFloatRest(ACC:Float, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => sumFloatRest(ACC, R)
    requires
      notBool (floatV(V) orBool integralV(V))
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining sumToFloat with its named no-float totalizer.
definitions.text:
rule sumToFloat(ACC:Int, .ValSeq) => noFloatSum(ACC)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recurrence defining the transition from an Int accumulator to the Float accumulator summary.
definitions.text:
rule sumToFloat(ACC:Int, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => sumFloatRest(addF(intToF(ACC), projectFloatTotal(V)), R)
    requires floatV(V)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recurrence defining sumToFloat while the sequence head remains integral.
definitions.text:
rule sumToFloat(ACC:Int, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => sumToFloat(ACC +Int intLikeTotal(V), R)
    requires integralV(V)
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded fallback recurrence completing the definition of sumToFloat off its numeric use domain.
definitions.text:
rule sumToFloat(ACC:Int, vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => sumToFloat(ACC, R)
    requires
      notBool (floatV(V) orBool integralV(V))
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines reverseSlice as the supplied buildVS traversal with the exact negative-step bounds.
definitions.text:
rule reverseSlice(VS:ValSeq)
    => buildVS(VS, vsLen(VS) +Int -1, -1, -1)
    [concrete]

definitions.rationale: Sorted base equation defining projectIntTotal on an already-known Int.
definitions.text: rule projectIntTotal(I:Int) => I [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded equation defining projectIntTotal for a dynamically sorted Val through the K Int projection.
definitions.text:
rule projectIntTotal(V:Val) => {V}:>Int
    requires
      isInt(V) andBool notBool isBool(V) andBool notBool isFloat(V)
    [concrete, simplification(10), preserves-definedness]

definitions.rationale: Sorted base equation defining projectBoolTotal on an already-known Bool.
definitions.text: rule projectBoolTotal(B:Bool) => B [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded equation defining projectBoolTotal for a dynamically sorted Val through the K Bool projection.
definitions.text:
rule projectBoolTotal(V:Val) => {V}:>Bool
    requires
      isBool(V) andBool notBool isInt(V) andBool notBool isFloat(V)
    [concrete, simplification(10), preserves-definedness]

definitions.rationale: Sorted base equation defining projectFloatTotal on an already-known Float.
definitions.text: rule projectFloatTotal(F:Float) => F [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded equation defining projectFloatTotal for a dynamically sorted Val through the K Float projection.
definitions.text:
rule projectFloatTotal(V:Val) => {V}:>Float
    requires floatV(V)
    [concrete, simplification(10), preserves-definedness]

definitions.rationale: Guarded equation defining intLikeTotal for the exclusive Int case.
definitions.text:
rule intLikeTotal(V:Val) => projectIntTotal(V)
    requires
      isInt(V) andBool notBool isBool(V) andBool notBool isFloat(V)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded equation defining intLikeTotal for the exclusive Bool case.
definitions.text:
rule intLikeTotal(V:Val)
    => #if projectBoolTotal(V) #then 1 #else 0 #fi
    requires
      isBool(V) andBool notBool isInt(V) andBool notBool isFloat(V)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Macro-defines willItFlyClosure as the exact translated closure syntax while leaving call and body execution to the supplied semantics.
definitions.text:
rule willItFlyClosure()
    => closureVal(
         ("q", "w", .ParamNames),
         Return(
           BoolOp(
             "and",
             ( Compare(
                 Name("q"),
                 CmpOp(
                   "==",
                   Subscript(
                     Name("q"),
                     Slice(
                       NoBound,
                       NoBound,
                       UnaryOp("-", Int(1))))))
             , Compare(
                 Call(Name("sum"), (Name("q"), .Exprs)),
                 CmpOp("<=", Name("w")))
             , .Exprs)))
           .Stmts,
         0)

proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: SUM-CONNECTION.reverse-slice first proves this exact arbitrary-suffix slice-continuation transition under SUMMARY-DEFINITION, whose import closure omits VERIFICATION and therefore omits this rule.

SUM-CONNECTION.sum-fold is proved first under bridge-free SUMMARY-DEFINITION with the identical transition and the broader allIntegral guard, so its theorem specializes to this rule's allIntegral-and-no-float domain.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule <k> #iterNext(list(VS:ValSeq)) ~> #sumCont(ACC:Int)
        => sumInts(ACC, VS) ... </k>
    requires allIntegral(VS) andBool notBool hasFloat(VS)
    [priority(40)]

proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: FLOAT-SUM-CONNECTION.float-sum-fold is proved before VERIFICATION is compiled, omits this rule, has the identical transition, and covers the broader allNumeric-and-hasFloat guard containing this rule's guarded domain.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule <k> #iterNext(list(VS:ValSeq)) ~> #sumCont(ACC:Int)
        => sumToFloat(ACC, VS) ... </k>
    requires
      allNumeric(VS)
      andBool hasFloat(VS)
      andBool notBool allIntegral(VS)
    [priority(39)]
